t: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
And establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].
And establish prayer and give zakah, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. Indeed, Allah of what you do, is Seeing.
So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
And your god is one God. There is no deity [worthy of worship] except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
O you who have believed, eat from the good things which We have provided for you and be grateful to Allah if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.
Maintain with care the [obligatory] prayers and [in particular] the middle prayer and stand before Allah, devoutly obedient.
Kind speech and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury. And Allah is Free of need and Forbearing.
He gives wisdom to whom He wills, and whoever has been given wisdom has certainly been given much good. And none will remember except those of understanding.
Indeed, from Allah nothing is hidden in the earth nor in the heaven.
He selects for His mercy whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allah] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it.
To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And to Allah will [all] matters be returned.
And obey Allah and the Messenger that you may obtain mercy.
So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is over all things competent.
Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding.
O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.
And Allah wants to lighten for you [your difficulties]; and mankind was created weak.
Indeed, Allah does not do injustice, [even] as much as an atom's weight; while if there is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward.
And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
And whoever does a wrong or wrongs himself but then seeks forgiveness of Allah will find Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
What would Allah do with your punishment if you are grateful and believe? And ever is Allah Appreciative and Knowing.
Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds [that] for them there is forgiveness and great reward.
O you who have believed, fear Allah and seek the means [of nearness] to Him and strive in His cause that you may succeed.
But whoever repents after his wrongdoing and reforms, indeed, Allah will turn to him in forgiveness. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. And He is over all things competent.
And He is Allah, [the only deity] in the heavens and the earth. He knows your secret and what you make public, and He knows that which you earn.
And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent.
Vision perceives Him not, but He perceives [all] vision; and He is the Subtle, the Acquainted.
And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can alter His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
And this [Qur'an] is a Book We have revealed [which is] blessed, so follow it and fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.
And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.
Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
So when the Qur'an is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.
And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.
And know that your properties and your children are but a trial and that Allah has with Him a great reward.
Say, "Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us; He is our protector." And upon Allah let the believers rely.
Indeed, to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and causes death. And you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper.
But if they turn away, [O Muhammad], say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne."
Say, "In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."
And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.
And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
And the reward of the Hereafter is better for those who believed and were fearing Allah.
And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.
My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.
Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.
Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
Indeed, this Qur'an guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward.
And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small."
And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully.
And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
And from [part of] the night, pray with it as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.
And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders.
And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
Do you not see that Allah has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted.
To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.
And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the destination.
Allah alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.
We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path.
And establish prayer and give zakah and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.
And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful, Who sees you when you arise And your movement among those who prostrate.
So rely upon Allah; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.
And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."
And out of His mercy He made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from His bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful.
O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.
And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Allah extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing.
And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.
So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.
To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allah that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allah often.
O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
O you who have believed, fear Allah and speak words of appropriate justice.
He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."
O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver.
O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
Indeed, Allah is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
Rather, worship [only] Allah and be among the grateful.
Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.
And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."
To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.
To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.
Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
And it is He who accepts repentance from his servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.
And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination.
And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.
The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith] And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Everyone upon the earth will perish, And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and he is Knowing of that within the breasts.
He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed.
O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.
He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things.
Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.
Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward.
Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
So be patient with gracious patience.
Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate, Honorable Owner of the Throne, Effecter of what He intends.
And We will ease you toward ease.
He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
As for he who gives and fears Allah And believes in the best [reward], We will ease him toward ease.
By the morning brightness And [by] the night when it covers with darkness, Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
And He found you lost and guided [you], And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]. And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
Is not Allah the most just of judges?
Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous - Who taught by the pen - Taught man that which he knew not.
The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
By time, Indeed, mankind is in loss, Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself.
Whoever observes fasts during the month of Ramadan out of sincere faith, and hoping to attain Allah's rewards, then all his past sins will be forgiven.
If a man spends on his family (with the intention of having a reward from Allah) sincerely for Allah's sake then it is a (kind of) alms-giving in reward for him.
You will be rewarded for whatever you spend for Allah's sake even if it were a morsel which you put in your wife's mouth.
Facilitate things to people (concerning religious matters), and do not make it hard for them and give them good tidings and do not make them run away (from Islam).
The real patience is at the first stroke of a calamity.
The poor person is not the one who asks a morsel or two (of meals) from the others, but the poor is the one who has nothing and is ashamed to beg from others.
Take Suhur as there is a blessing in it.
No doubt, it is better for any one of you to cut a bundle of wood and carry it over his back rather than to ask someone who may or may not give him.
May Allah's mercy be on him who is lenient in his buying, selling, and in demanding back his money.
Oppression will be a darkness on the Day of Resurrection.
The most hated person in the sight of Allah is the most quarrelsome person.
While a man was on the way, he found a thorny branch of a tree there on the way and removed it. Allah thanked him for that deed and forgave him.
Give (in charity) and do not give reluctantly lest Allah should give you in a limited amount; and do not withhold your money lest Allah should withhold it from you.
If somebody innovates something which is not in harmony with the principles of our religion, that thing is rejected.
The signs of a hypocrite are three: Whenever he speaks he tells a lie; whenever he is entrusted he proves dishonest; whenever he promises he breaks his promise.
A place in Paradise equal to the size of a lash is better than the whole world and whatever is in it.
Paradise has eight gates, and one of them is called Ar-Raiyan through which none will enter but those who observe fasting.
A man's spending on his family is a deed of charity.
If somebody recited the last two Verses of Surat Al-Baqara at night, that will be sufficient for him.
Commit yourself to the Qur'an, for by Him in whose Hand is my soul, it is surely more prone to break away than a camel in its bind.
The best alms is that which you give when you are rich, and you should start first to support your dependants.
The food for two persons is sufficient for three, and the food of three persons is sufficient for four persons.
If Allah wants to do good to somebody, He afflicts him with trials.
There is no disease that Allah has created, except that He also has created its treatment.
If any Muslim plants any plant and a human being or an animal eats of it, he will be rewarded as if he had given that much in charity.
Gabriel continued to recommend me about treating the neighbors Kindly and politely so much so that I thought he would order me to make them as my heirs.
Everyone will be with those whom he loves.
Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His slave than anyone of you is pleased with finding his camel which he had lost in the desert.
Whoever says, 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi,' one hundred times a day, will be forgiven all his sins even if they were as much as the foam of the sea.
Wealth is not in having many possessions, but rather (true) wealth is feeling sufficiency in the soul.
The (Hell) Fire is surrounded by all kinds of desires and passions, while Paradise is surrounded by all kinds of disliked undesirable things.
If anyone of you looked at a person who was made superior to him in property and (in good) appearance, then he should also look at the one who is inferior to him.
The worst of all mankind is the double-faced one, who comes to some people with one face and to others, with another face.
When Allah had finished His creation, He wrote over his Throne: 'My Mercy preceded My Anger.'
The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.
Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.
The best among you (Muslims) are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.
The best amongst you are those who have the best manners and character.
He who is not merciful to others, will not be treated mercifully.
Allah will not be merciful to those who are not merciful to mankind.
Save yourself from Hell-fire even by giving half a date-fruit in charity.
Do not become angry.
Make things easy for the people, and do not make it difficult for them, and make them calm (with glad tidings) and do not repulse (them).
Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and set free the captives.
A believer is not stung twice (by something) out of one and the same hole.
O boy! Mention the Name of Allah and eat with your right hand, and eat of the dish what is nearer to you.
Iman has over seventy branches, and modesty is a branch of Iman.
The five (daily) prayers and one Friday prayer to (the next) Friday prayer are expiations (for the sins committed in the intervals) between them.
He who went towards the mosque in the morning or evening, Allah would arrange a feast for him morning or evening in Paradise.
He who observed prayer at night during Ramadan, because of faith and seeking his reward from Allah, his previous sins would be forgiven.
The house in which remembrance of Allah is made and the house in which Allah is not remembered are like the living and the dead.
Every act of goodness is sadaqa.
An Umra is an expiation for the sins committed between it and the next, and Hajj which is accepted will receive no other reward than Paradise.
A believing man should not hate a believing woman; if he dislikes one of her characteristics, he will be pleased with another.
If you are three, two should not converse secretly to the exclusion of your companion for that hurts his feelings.
He who is presented with a flower should not reject it, for it is light to carry and pleasant in odour.
The finest act of goodness is that a person should treat kindly the loved ones of his father.
The tie of kinship is suspended to the Throne and says: He who unites me Allah would unite him and he who severed me Allah would sever him.
He who likes that his sustenance should be expanded and his age may be lengthened should join the tie of kinship.
It is not permissible for a Muslim to have estranged relations with his brother beyond three days.
Don't bear aversion against one another and don't be jealous of one another and be servants of Allah.
Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth but He looks to your heart and to your deeds.
He who visits the sick continues to remain in the fruit garden of Paradise until he returns.
A believer does not receive (the trouble) of running a thorn or more than that but Allah elevates him in rank or effaces his sins because of that.
Never a believer is stricken with discomfort, hardship or illness, grief or even with mental worry that his sins are not expiated for him.
A believer is like a brick for another believer, the one supporting the other.
The believers are like one person; if his head aches, the whole body aches with fever and sleeplessness.
The servant (who conceals) the faults of others in this world, Allah would conceal his faults on the Day of Resurrection.
He who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good.
Kindness is not to be found in anything but that it adds to its beauty and it is not withdrawn from anything but it makes it defective.
When one of you makes supplication, he should supplicate with a will and should not say: O Allah, confer upon me if Thou likest, for there is none to coerce Allah.
He who loves to meet Allah, Allah also loves to meet him, and he who dislikes to meet Allah, Allah also abhors to meet him.
There is no believing servant who supplicates for his brother behind his back (in his absence) that the Angels do not say: The same be for you too.
Allah is pleased with His servant who says: Al-Hamdu lillah while taking a morsel of food and while drinking.
The supplication of every one of you is granted if he does not grow impatient and says: I supplicated but it was not granted.
The world is a prison-house for a believer and Paradise for a non-believer.
There are two blessings that many people are deceived into losing: health and free time.
